nuggets.text: The Bearkats play at Bowers Stadium for the first time in 652 days, christening a $60 million renovation.
Bearkats fans get LED wristbands for the Tulsa game, synced to light up the whole stadium at once.
Bearkats QB Landyn Locke threw for a career-high 335 yards at Troy, completing passes to nine different receivers.
The Bearkats won the 2020 FCS title in May 2021, scoring the winning touchdown with 16 seconds left.
Bearkats coach Phil Longo once said the thing he loves most, after his wife and kids, is slot receivers.
Phil Longo picked up the Air Raid offense after meeting Mike Leach at a coaching clinic in the late 1990s.
Phil Longo was once the Bearkats' offensive coordinator, when his offense averaged 547 yards a game in a 12-1 season.
The Bearkats' 1964 NAIA national title came in a 7-7 tie with Concordia College.
Former Bearkats QB Josh McCown played 18 NFL seasons and was the last active player from the 2002 draft class.
Landyn Locke's 335 yards at Troy were the most by a Bearkats passer since Eric Schmid threw for 359 in 2021.
